from_speaker: OpenAI will simply run out of money
our_interpretation: Run out of money means exhausting available liquidity and being unable to pay obligations when due.
Accounting losses, projected cash burn and seeking financing do not alone establish cash exhaustion.
At some point supplies no deadline. The nearby reference to 2027 is not imported as one.
No accounting basis for cash or liquidity is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Dated financial or legal records establish that OpenAI exhausted available liquidity and could not pay due obligations.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Continued solvency at any finite date does not contradict eventually. A definitive end to OpenAI's operations with all obligations satisfied and no prior liquidity failure could foreclose the predicted event.
